opening.title: Security and DevSecOps Engineer
opening.summary: On a contract basis, review and harden our infrastructure, application security and deployment pipeline.
opening.about: We take security seriously because our customers trust us with their money. This contract brings in specialist experience to review what we have, find what we missed and help us fix it properly.
owns: Security reviews of the backend, web and mobile apps.
Hardening of infrastructure, secrets handling and the deployment pipeline.
Findings written up with clear fixes and priorities.
responsibilities: Review authentication, authorisation, webhooks and data storage.
Test for common and product-specific vulnerabilities.
Work with engineers to fix findings and verify the fixes.
requirements: Proven experience in application or cloud security.
Ability to explain findings clearly to engineers and the founder.
niceToHave: Experience securing payment or crypto systems.
success: A prioritised list of findings, each with a fix that has been verified.
